recap: Jarrett Allen led the Cavaliers with 30 points (12-20 FG, 0-1 3PT), 10 rebounds and 2 assists.
Norman Powell led the Heat with 27 points (10-18 FG, 5-10 3PT), 2 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 50.0 to 55.9.
Biggest swing: Luke Travers blocks Simone Fontecchio's 8-foot cutting layup shot (Q4 10:20), +15 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Nance, Hunter, Travers, Porter, Proctor, -3 in 4:29.
Bench points: CLE 51, MIA 32. Points in the paint: 58–56. Second-chance points: 27–13.
